source: Static repository audit focused on data safety, local-first image workflows, RAG robustness, and maintainability.

summary.currentFocus: Stabilize the local-first user experience before adding new features.
highestRiskAreas: Automatic local data reset on schema mismatch
Hugging Face image-model downloads fetching full repository snapshots instead of required files only
Hidden prompt mutation in image generation presets and runtime defaults
Download cancellation that does not actually cancel active transfers
RAG retrieval hard-failing when embedding or vector search is unavailable
recommendedExecutionOrder: Protect user data and schema migration paths
Fix image-model download size, validation, cancellation, and atomicity
Make image prompts and runtime profiles transparent and user-controlled
Improve RAG degradation behavior when local services are unavailable
Refactor composition and contracts for long-term maintainability

todos: Replace automatic data-root reset on schema mismatch with explicit migrations, pre-reset backup, and user-visible recovery flow. The application must never silently delete local user data, indexes, chats, OCR cache, logs, or generated artifacts because a schema version is unexpected.

Refactor the Hugging Face image-model downloader so built-in SDXL/ONNX entries download only the required files declared by ImageModelCatalog instead of fetching the full repository snapshot. Preserve the expected Diffusers/ONNX directory layout and skip unrelated assets such as alternate weight formats, previews, examples, duplicate precision variants, and training artifacts.

Add strict download validation for image models: show expectedSizeBytes as GB before consent, check that every required file exists after download, surface a clear error when a required file is missing, and keep the existing local model state consistent when a partial download fails.

Make image-model downloads atomic. Download into a staging directory, validate all required files, then rename into the final model directory only after validation succeeds. Clean stale staging directories safely on startup.

Implement real image-model download cancellation with per-download CancellationTokenSource instances. Cancel must stop active network reads, mark the model as cancelled, clean incomplete staging files, and leave any previous valid local model untouched.

Remove built-in image models that are too large for a normal desktop install or not suitable for distribution because of license terms. Do not keep presets that point to full repositories around 70 GB or to non-commercial model licenses.

Keep a single manageable built-in Hugging Face model that can be downloaded directly by the app. Prefer the OpenRAIL++ DirectML/CPU ONNX candidate softwareweaver/Latent-Consistency-xl-Olive-Onnx, set a non-zero expectedSizeBytes value around 8_000_000_000 bytes, and verify the declared GB value in the UI.

Limit the Images section to local-only operations. Remove UI actions and copy that imply external sharing, publishing, or cloud handoff. Generated and edited images must remain local unless the user explicitly exports a local file through normal file-system controls.

Add a crop operation to the Images section. The crop workflow must allow selecting an area, applying the crop locally, preserving the original file unless the user chooses to replace it, and saving the cropped result as a local image artifact.

Remove create-image prompt presets. The user's prompt text must remain the primary and only creative request source sent to the image runtime; the app must not add hidden style directives, subject directives, scene templates, negative-prompt recipes, or prompt embellishments behind preset names.

Replace image-generation presets with only three runtime profiles for built-in models: quality, balanced, and performance. These profiles may adjust only technical parameters such as steps, guidance, scheduler profile, width, height, seed behavior, and GPU preference; they must not inject creative content or alter the user's request.

Allow all generation parameters to be edited manually. When the user changes any parameter controlled by a profile, automatically switch the active profile to custom and preserve the manual values instead of snapping back to quality, balanced, or performance.

Apply RequestTimeoutSeconds during image generation by linking the user cancellation token with a timeout token. Surface timeout errors distinctly from model-load errors, engine errors, and user cancellation.

For manually added image models, expose required configuration fields instead of assuming built-in defaults: model id, display name, download URL or local path, license label, expected size in bytes, required files, model type/profile, supported resolutions, default steps, default guidance, scheduler expectation, and GPU/CPU compatibility notes.

Make hybrid RAG retrieval degrade gracefully. If embedding or Qdrant vector search is unavailable, continue with keyword retrieval, include a clear retrieval notice, and reserve 503 hard failures for cases where no retrieval backend can answer the request.

Add a small retrieval evaluation harness with representative local queries, expected source chunks, recall@k, MRR, and context-size metrics. Use it before changing keyword/vector weights, chunking, or ranking logic.

Split the backend composition root into focused extension methods for storage, retrieval, OCR, images, Ollama, diagnostics, jobs, and endpoint mapping. Preserve current behavior while reducing startup coupling.
Reduce TypeScript/C# API contract drift by generating TypeScript types from the backend contract or by adding contract snapshot tests for key request and response DTOs.

Test the final image workflow on CPU and DirectML GPU, including NVIDIA cards with 8 GB VRAM. Validate download size display, selective required-file download, cancellation, model loading, generation with quality/balanced/performance/custom profiles, manual model configuration, crop, local save, timeout behavior, and CPU fallback.

phase1DataSafety.goal: Prevent accidental local data loss and make schema evolution explicit.

tasks.title: Replace destructive schema mismatch reset
tasks.details: Remove automatic AppDataReset execution from schema initialization. Return a structured state such as Current, MigrationRequired, UnsupportedSchema, or CorruptDatabase instead of deleting the data root.
acceptanceCriteria: Opening an older schema never deletes user files automatically.
The app reports the schema state in a user-visible way.
Tests cover old schema, future schema, missing schema metadata, and corrupt database cases.

tasks.title: Introduce schema migrations
tasks.details: Create a schema_migrations table and incremental migration handlers. Each migration must be idempotent or guarded by an applied migration record.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh installs create the latest schema directly.
Existing installs migrate forward without data loss.
Migration failure preserves the pre-migration database.

tasks.title: Add backup before destructive maintenance
tasks.details: Any reset or destructive repair path must create a timestamped backup of databases, indexes, chats, generated images, and settings before continuing.
acceptanceCriteria: A backup path is displayed to the user before destructive action.
Backup creation failure blocks the destructive action.
Backup restore is documented for manual recovery.

phase2ImageModelDownloads.goal: Make model download size predictable, cancellable, validated, and compatible with normal desktop storage limits.

tasks.title: Download only required Hugging Face files
tasks.details: Pass each catalog model's requiredFiles into the Hugging Face downloader. Avoid recursive full snapshot download for built-in models.
acceptanceCriteria: Network requests are made only for declared required files and minimal metadata needed for validation.
Directory layout matches the runtime loader expectation.
Unrelated files such as previews, examples, duplicate precision variants, and training artifacts are skipped.

tasks.title: Validate model download completeness
tasks.details: After download, verify that every required file exists and has a non-zero size. Where practical, add expected file size or checksum metadata later.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing required files produce a clear actionable error.
Partial downloads are not marked installed.
The previous installed model remains usable after a failed update.

tasks.title: Use atomic staging directories
tasks.details: Write downloads to a temporary staging directory. Move to final location only after validation succeeds. Clean abandoned staging directories on startup if no active download owns them.
acceptanceCriteria: The final model directory is never a partially valid state.
Cancellation and failure remove or quarantine staging files.
Startup cleanup does not delete valid installed models.

tasks.title: Implement real cancellation
tasks.details: Track active downloads with CancellationTokenSource per model id. The cancel endpoint must signal the token and await or observe cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: Cancelling stops active HTTP reads promptly.
UI state transitions through cancelling/cancelled instead of pretending the download disappeared.
A cancelled download can be restarted cleanly.

tasks.title: Curate built-in downloadable models
tasks.details: Keep only a manageable default model with compatible license and desktop-sized expected download. Remove or hide catalog entries that imply huge downloads or unsuitable license terms.
acceptanceCriteria: Built-in catalog has no non-commercial default model.
Built-in catalog has no default entry that downloads an unexpectedly huge repository.
The UI shows expected size before user consent.

phase3ImageWorkflowTransparency.goal: Ensure generated image output is controlled by explicit user input and visible technical parameters only.

tasks.title: Remove hidden prompt embellishment
tasks.details: Delete quality/style suffix injection and any preset that appends creative directives to the user's prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: The prompt sent to the runtime exactly matches the user's prompt unless the user edits it explicitly.
Negative prompt defaults are either empty or visible and editable before generation.
Tests assert prompt pass-through behavior.

tasks.title: Replace creative presets with technical runtime profiles
tasks.details: Keep quality, balanced, performance, and custom. Profiles may alter steps, guidance, scheduler, width, height, seed policy, timeout, and GPU preference only.
acceptanceCriteria: Profiles do not modify prompt or negative prompt text.
Manual edits switch the active profile to custom.
Profile-derived parameters are visible before generation.

tasks.title: Keep image operations local-only
tasks.details: Remove UI labels, commands, or copy that suggest publishing, sharing, or cloud handoff. Allow explicit local export through file-system controls only.
acceptanceCriteria: No default image operation sends generated files outside the local machine.
Export paths are explicit user choices.
Generated and edited image metadata remains local.

tasks.title: Add crop workflow
tasks.details: Implement local crop selection, preview, apply, and save-as behavior. Preserve the original unless the user explicitly replaces it.
acceptanceCriteria: Crop can save a new local artifact.
Replace original requires explicit user action.
Crop works offline and does not require model runtime.

tasks.title: Apply generation timeout setting
tasks.details: Use RequestTimeoutSeconds to create a linked cancellation token for image generation. Show distinct messages for timeout, cancellation, missing model, and engine failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Generation stops when the configured timeout elapses.
User cancellation remains distinct from timeout.
Timeout behavior is covered by tests or a deterministic fake engine.

phase4RagRobustness.goal: Make RAG useful even when optional local services are unavailable or degraded.

tasks.title: Add keyword-only fallback
tasks.details: If embedding generation or Qdrant vector search fails, continue with SQLite FTS keyword retrieval and attach a retrieval notice instead of returning a hard failure when keyword results exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Qdrant offline still allows keyword-based answers with a clear notice.
Embedding model unavailable still allows keyword-based answers with a clear notice.
No-context cases remain explicit and do not fabricate sources.

tasks.title: Create retrieval evaluation harness
tasks.details: Add a small local eval set with representative documents, queries, expected chunks, recall@k, MRR, and context-size metrics. Run it before ranking, chunking, or weighting changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Eval command can run locally without cloud services.
Baseline metrics are committed or documented.
Ranking changes report before/after metrics.

tasks.title: Review hybrid ranking and context budget
tasks.details: Tune keyword/vector weights, overlap behavior, and MaxContextCharacters using eval results instead of static assumptions. Consider diversity/MMR if context redundancy is high.
acceptanceCriteria: Weights have documented rationale.
Context selection avoids repeated chunks from the same local area when better diverse evidence exists.
Changes do not regress recall@k on the eval set.

phase5Maintainability.goal: Reduce coupling and contract drift after the P0 behavior fixes are complete.

tasks.title: Split backend dependency registration
tasks.details: Move service registration into focused extension methods: AddOnlyRagStorage, AddOnlyRagRetrieval, AddOnlyRagOcr, AddOnlyRagImages, AddOnlyRagOllama, AddOnlyRagDiagnostics, and AddOnlyRagJobs.
acceptanceCriteria: Application bootstrap remains behaviorally equivalent.
Each extension method has a narrow dependency area.
Tests can construct individual modules without full application startup.

tasks.title: Split endpoint mapping by feature
tasks.details: Move endpoint groups into MapOnlyRagDocuments, MapOnlyRagChat, MapOnlyRagImages, MapOnlyRagDiagnostics, and MapOnlyRagSettings.
acceptanceCriteria: Routes and auth requirements remain unchanged.
Endpoint tests continue to pass.
Feature files are small enough to review independently.

tasks.title: Reduce C# and TypeScript DTO drift
tasks.details: Either generate TypeScript contracts from backend metadata or add JSON snapshot tests covering key DTOs and enum/string states used by the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: DTO shape changes fail tests unless snapshots or generated types are updated.
Image model, image generation, chat, retrieval notice, and document DTOs are covered.
UI code imports shared/generated types where practical.

checks: Startup cleanup of stale staging directory
Manual parameter override switches to custom
DirectML GPU on NVIDIA 8 GB VRAM
Backend starts with split DI modules
